single_dose: adults 1000 mg (875 mg amoxicillin + 125 mg clavulanic acid) || children 600 mg (400 mg amoxicillin + 42.9 mg clavulanic acid)
mechanism_of_action: blocks the synthesis of the cell wall of microorganisms and has a bactericidal effect
side_effects: prolonged bleeding time, allergic skin reactions, gastrointestinal issues
unsuitable_population: patients with renal impairment, patients receiving anticoagulants, pregnant women
storage_conditions: store at room temperature||keep tightly closed
